tldr: Repeated trials cannot accompany every updated human--AI policy, and in pretrial applications ground truth is revealed only by an endogenous action. The paper identifies the exact observable--target image of legal finite response types and makes the SLCC-specific primitive bracket-stratum construction its structural headline: an arbitrary-finite extension of the exact thirty-two-row quotient, a bracket-supported law with two exact \(199/800\) full-versus-label-blind gaps, and a small full-support mixture yielding a nonempty relative-interior region of two-sided improvement. The optimal-dual-face equivalence is used as a generic LP diagnostic for that construction. Generic simultaneous multinomial confidence-region propagation supplies a finite-sample implementation corollary. At boundary laws, Euclidean projection has the paired LP directional limit, and an explicit centered \(m\)-out-of-\(n\) subsampling schedule gives pointwise fixed-law conservative simultaneous endpoint coverage even at the certified nondegenerate zero atom; no uniform-validity, first-atom-aware, or dominance claim is made.
gap: ZhangSkalnesChenOberst2026 does not claim tightness under its unit-level restrictions and treats only a restricted missing-label mechanism. DuarteFinkelsteinKnoxMummoloShpitser2024 supplies generic finite response-function optimization and confidence-region propagation, but not the legal action-dependent selective-label quotient or a strict full-versus-blind region.
